title: 鐵路號誌失效安全分析~Fail-safe analysis of railway signaling
focus: 號誌危害邏輯共同原因與證據鏈~Signalling hazard logic common causes and evidence chains
summary: 本課聚焦號誌危害邏輯共同原因與證據鏈。從頂事件邏輯選擇建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把安全性質的狀態域與危害需求追溯連成可驗證的介面，最後以變更後證據重建整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。~This course studies signalling hazard logic common causes and evidence chains. Start with selecting top-event logic to define physical or information boundaries, connect state domain of safety properties with tracing hazards to requirements as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through rebuilding evidence after change. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
history: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2002 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法早期版發布。；2023 年歐盟列控技術規則二零二三號一六九五發布。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對號誌危害邏輯共同原因與證據鏈而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用共同原因殘餘風險及故障時間窗一致性連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。~The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2002: An early railway RAMS specification was published. 2023: European Commission Regulation twenty-twenty-three slash sixteen-ninety-five was adopted. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For signalling hazard logic common causes and evidence chains, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through residual common-cause risk and consistent fault time windows. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
example: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究頂事件邏輯選擇。原創假想教學輸入：事件一機率 p1=0.001 1；事件二機率 p2=0.002 1。公式 y=p1+p2-p1*p2，代入得 y=0.002998 1。邊界：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。敏感度只改 p1=0.001 至 0.0011 1，輸出變為 0.0030978 1；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究共同原因殘餘風險：原創假想教學輸入：獨立支路失效機率 p=0.002 1；共同原因事件機率 common=0.0001 1。公式 y=common+(1-common)*p*p，代入得 y=0.000104 1。邊界：共同原因先發生的簡化條件模型，其餘支路相互獨立；非安全等級認證。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元先辨認任一失效與同時失效的差別，再以原創機率練習檢查失效樹的邏輯。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。~Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate selecting top-event logic. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: event one probability p1=0.001 1; event two probability p2=0.002 1. Formula y=p1+p2-p1*p2 gives y=0.002998 1. Boundary: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour. For sensitivity, change only p1=0.001 to 0.0011 1; the output becomes 0.0030978 1. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate residual common-cause risk: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent branch failure probability p=0.002 1; common-cause event probability common=0.0001 1. Formula y=common+(1-common)*p*p gives y=0.000104 1. Boundary: Simple conditional model with common cause considered first and remaining branches independent; no safety-level certification is implied. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Distinguish either-failure from simultaneous-failure conditions before using original probability exercises to check fault-tree logic. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.

units.anchor: 頂事件邏輯選擇~Selecting top-event logic
units.title: 頂事件邏輯選擇~Selecting top-event logic
units.mechanism: 本單元先辨認任一失效與同時失效的差別，再以原創機率練習檢查失效樹的邏輯。只要任一支路失效就產生頂事件時，需計算聯集而不是把兩機率相乘。獨立假設允許扣掉交集的乘積，若共享電源、環境或軟體則交集另有結構；事件樹和失效樹必須保持同一任務時間。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。~Distinguish either-failure from simultaneous-failure conditions before using original probability exercises to check fault-tree logic. When either branch can trigger the top event, the relevant probability is a union rather than a product. Independence permits the intersection to be written as a product; shared power, environment or software changes that intersection. Event and fault trees must use the same mission duration. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：事件一機率 p1=0.001 1；事件二機率 p2=0.002 1。公式 y=p1+p2-p1*p2，代入得 y=0.002998 1。邊界：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: event one probability p1=0.001 1; event two probability p2=0.002 1. Formula y=p1+p2-p1*p2 gives y=0.002998 1. Boundary: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour.
units.verify: 先畫頂事件邏輯再代機率，明列共享資源並檢查事件時間窗是否一致。以「頂事件邏輯選擇」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Draw top-event logic before inserting probabilities, list shared resources, and check consistent time windows. For selecting top-event logic, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 把聯集誤寫成交集會低估危險；混合年度機率與每小時機率則使結果失去量綱意義。回到「頂事件邏輯選擇」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Confusing a union with an intersection understates risk; mixing annual and hourly probabilities destroys the intended meaning. Trace the input chain for selecting top-event logic. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 任一支路故障即失效時總機率等於兩機率相乘~If either branch failure is sufficient, total failure probability equals their product.
units.practice: 只把事件一機率 p1 從 0.001 改成 0.0011 1（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.002998 變為 0.0030978 1。先說明「頂事件邏輯選擇」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only event one probability p1 from 0.001 to 0.0011 1 (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.002998 to 0.0030978 1. Explain the causal direction for selecting top-event logic, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 共同原因殘餘風險~Residual common-cause risk
units.title: 共同原因殘餘風險~Residual common-cause risk
units.mechanism: 本單元將共享電源、環境與需求錯誤列入雙通道分析，觀察獨立故障降低後何者成為主導。兩支路都失效才失去功能的架構可降低獨立故障貢獻，卻不能消除共同原因。共同電源、相同軟體缺陷或同處淹水會同時影響兩支路；因此增加硬體數量不能取代分離、異質性與失效偵測的證據。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：共同原因先發生的簡化條件模型，其餘支路相互獨立；非安全等級認證。~Include shared power, environment and requirement errors in a dual-channel analysis, observing what dominates after independent failures are reduced. A function lost only when both branches fail can reduce independent contributions but cannot eliminate common causes. Shared power, identical software defects or flooding at one location can affect both branches. More hardware does not replace evidence for separation, diversity and fault detection. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Simple conditional model with common cause considered first and remaining branches independent; no safety-level certification is implied.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立支路失效機率 p=0.002 1；共同原因事件機率 common=0.0001 1。公式 y=common+(1-common)*p*p，代入得 y=0.000104 1。邊界：共同原因先發生的簡化條件模型，其餘支路相互獨立；非安全等級認證。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent branch failure probability p=0.002 1; common-cause event probability common=0.0001 1. Formula y=common+(1-common)*p*p gives y=0.000104 1. Boundary: Simple conditional model with common cause considered first and remaining branches independent; no safety-level certification is implied.
units.verify: 把獨立與共同原因兩類試驗分開，在隔離試驗台檢查共享介面失效的影響。以「共同原因殘餘風險」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Separate independent and common-cause tests, using an isolated bench to examine failures of shared interfaces. For residual common-cause risk, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 共享電源中斷會讓看似雙備援同時失去功能，若故障偵測也共用同一支路更可能誤報正常。回到「共同原因殘餘風險」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Loss of a shared supply can defeat apparently duplicated equipment, especially if fault detection depends on that same branch. Trace the input chain for residual common-cause risk. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 裝設兩套相同設備就能完全消除共同原因故障~Installing two identical systems completely removes common-cause failures.
units.practice: 只把共同原因事件機率 common 從 0.0001 改成 0.00011 1（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.000104 變為 0.000114 1。先說明「共同原因殘餘風險」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only common-cause event probability common from 0.0001 to 0.00011 1 (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.000104 to 0.000114 1. Explain the causal direction for residual common-cause risk, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 安全性與可用度分離~Separating safety and availability
units.title: 安全性與可用度分離~Separating safety and availability
units.mechanism: 本單元比較安全停止與危險繼續輸出兩種後果，避免以服務持續時間推論危害發生機率。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。~Compare safe withdrawal with hazardous continued output, avoiding inference of hazard probability from service uptime. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Formula y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr) gives y=0.998004 1. Boundary: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.
units.verify: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。以「安全性與可用度分離」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality. For separating safety and availability, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。回到「安全性與可用度分離」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Trace the input chain for separating safety and availability. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的~High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.
units.practice: 只把平均修復時間 mttr 從 4 改成 4.4 h（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.998004 變為 0.997805 1。先說明「安全性與可用度分離」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only mean repair time mttr from 4 to 4.4 h (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.998004 to 0.997805 1. Explain the causal direction for separating safety and availability, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 安全性質的狀態域~State domain of safety properties
units.title: 安全性質的狀態域~State domain of safety properties
units.mechanism: 本單元定義性質需涵蓋的可達狀態，特別保留故障與恢復而不只列正常運轉。布林狀態組合隨變數個數指數成長，這說明逐一人工檢查很快失去效率。可達性約束能排除不可能組合，但刪除條件必須有證據；安全性質通常針對所有可達狀態，而非幾個畫面上看起來合理的狀態。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。~Define the reachable states over which a property must hold, retaining fault and recovery states rather than only normal operation. Boolean combinations grow exponentially with variable count, explaining why manual enumeration soon becomes ineffective. Reachability constraints can eliminate impossible combinations, but each exclusion needs justification. Safety properties normally concern every reachable state rather than a few states that look plausible on a display. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。公式 y=2**bits，代入得 y=256 states。邊界：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits. Formula y=2**bits gives y=256 states. Boundary: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.
units.verify: 用小型模型列舉轉移，再與需求允許的轉移表比較，對被排除狀態留下理由。以「安全性質的狀態域」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Enumerate transitions in a small model, compare against the required transition table, and document reasons for excluded states. For state domain of safety properties, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 把感測器故障狀態預先刪掉會讓證明失去關鍵邊界，狀態抽象過粗也可能隱藏時序競爭。回到「安全性質的狀態域」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Excluding sensor-fault states can remove the crucial boundary from a proof; overly coarse abstraction may hide timing races. Trace the input chain for state domain of safety properties. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合~Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
units.practice: 只把布林變數數量 bits 從 8 改成 9 bits（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 256 變為 512 states。先說明「安全性質的狀態域」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only number of Boolean state variables bits from 8 to 9 bits (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 256 to 512 states. Explain the causal direction for state domain of safety properties, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 偵測與安全反應時間~Detection and safe-response timing
units.title: 偵測與安全反應時間~Detection and safe-response timing
units.mechanism: 本單元串接異常感測、判定與安全反應時間，清楚標示各段假設與未建模的致動延遲。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。~Link anomaly sensing, decision and safe response timing, explicitly marking assumptions and actuator delays not represented by a model. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。公式 y=sense+network+compute+actuate，代入得 y=0.25 s。邊界：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s. Formula y=sense+network+compute+actuate gives y=0.25 s. Boundary: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.
units.verify: 沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。以「偵測與安全反應時間」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load. For detection and safe-response timing, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。回到「偵測與安全反應時間」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. Trace the input chain for detection and safe-response timing. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短~Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
units.practice: 只把網路時間 network 從 0.08 改成 0.088 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.25 變為 0.258 s。先說明「偵測與安全反應時間」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only network time network from 0.08 to 0.088 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.25 to 0.258 s. Explain the causal direction for detection and safe-response timing, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 故障資訊可靠傳遞~Reliable transfer of fault information
units.title: 故障資訊可靠傳遞~Reliable transfer of fault information
units.mechanism: 本單元比較獨立丟包與共同失聯對故障通報的影響，將訊息可靠送達與仍然及時分開。獨立封包遺失可以相乘得到連續遺失機率，但實際無線遮蔽常造成成串遺失。增加重送次數會占用時間與頻寬，不能把可靠度與時效分開最佳化；舊封包即使最後送達，也可能已不適合當前控制。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：明確假設各次遺失獨立同分布，不適用遮蔽引起的相關失聯。~Compare independent losses and common outages in fault reporting, separating eventual delivery from delivery while the information remains timely. Independent packet losses multiply to give a consecutive-loss probability, but radio obstruction often causes correlated bursts. Retransmissions consume time and bandwidth, so reliability and freshness cannot be optimized independently. A packet eventually delivered may already be too old for the current control decision. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Losses are explicitly independent and identically distributed; correlated outages are outside the model.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立遺失率 p=0.02 1；連續封包數 n=3 packets。公式 y=p**n，代入得 y=8e-06 1。邊界：明確假設各次遺失獨立同分布，不適用遮蔽引起的相關失聯。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent loss probability p=0.02 1; consecutive packet count n=3 packets. Formula y=p**n gives y=8e-06 1. Boundary: Losses are explicitly independent and identically distributed; correlated outages are outside the model.
units.verify: 同時統計單包遺失率與最長連續遺失段，將結果和獨立模型比較以辨識相關性。以「故障資訊可靠傳遞」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Measure single-packet loss and the longest loss burst together, then compare them with the independent model to identify correlation. For reliable transfer of fault information, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 把成串失聯當成獨立事件會嚴重低估尾端風險，時間戳重排也可能讓重送掩蓋陳舊資料。回到「故障資訊可靠傳遞」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Treating burst outages as independent events understates tail risk; reordered timestamps may also hide stale retransmissions. Trace the input chain for reliable transfer of fault information. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 只知道平均丟包率就能完全判定通訊可靠性~The mean packet-loss rate completely determines communication reliability.
units.practice: 只把獨立遺失率 p 從 0.02 改成 0.022 1（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 8e-06 變為 1.0648e-05 1。先說明「故障資訊可靠傳遞」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only independent loss probability p from 0.02 to 0.022 1 (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 8e-06 to 1.0648e-05 1. Explain the causal direction for reliable transfer of fault information, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 危害需求追溯~Tracing hazards to requirements
units.title: 危害需求追溯~Tracing hazards to requirements
units.mechanism: 本單元建立危害、控制措施、需求與試驗的連結，將缺少證據的項目明列而不以總百分比掩蓋。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Link hazards, controls, requirements and tests, listing missing evidence explicitly rather than concealing it inside an overall percentage. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.verify: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「危害需求追溯」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. For tracing hazards to requirements, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「危害需求追溯」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for tracing hazards to requirements. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險~One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
units.practice: 只把已執行案例 tested 從 72 改成 73 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.8 變為 0.811111 1。先說明「危害需求追溯」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only executed cases tested from 72 to 73 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.8 to 0.811111 1. Explain the causal direction for tracing hazards to requirements, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 零失效證據解讀~Interpreting zero-failure evidence
units.title: 零失效證據解讀~Interpreting zero-failure evidence
units.mechanism: 本單元從有限試驗推導單側機率上界，說明不能以零失敗取代系統性故障的設計論證。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。~Derive a one-sided probability bound from finite trials and explain why zero failures cannot replace arguments about systematic design faults. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability. Independent Bernoulli trials allow a one-sided upper bound from the probability of all successes, which decreases with sample count. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
units.verify: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「零失效證據解讀」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For interpreting zero-failure evidence, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「零失效證據解讀」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Trace the input chain for interpreting zero-failure evidence. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零~Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
units.practice: 只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「零失效證據解讀」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for interpreting zero-failure evidence, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 故障時間窗一致性~Consistent fault time windows
units.title: 故障時間窗一致性~Consistent fault time windows
units.mechanism: 本單元核對失效事件與任務期間的定義，避免把不同時間窗的紀錄直接放進同一風險模型。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。~Check definitions of failure events and mission duration, avoiding combination of records from different time windows in one risk model. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Synchronization jumps can distort interval lengths, so clock quality and correction events must be recorded. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Formula y=drift*1e-6*duration gives y=0.072 s. Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.
units.verify: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。以「故障時間窗一致性」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump. For consistent fault time windows, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。回到「故障時間窗一致性」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Trace the input chain for consistent fault time windows. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致~Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
units.practice: 只把未校時期間 duration 從 3600 改成 3960 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072 變為 0.0792 s。先說明「故障時間窗一致性」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only unsynchronized interval duration from 3600 to 3960 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.072 to 0.0792 s. Explain the causal direction for consistent fault time windows, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 變更後證據重建~Rebuilding evidence after change
units.title: 變更後證據重建~Rebuilding evidence after change
units.mechanism: 本單元分析設計變更影響哪些需求和試驗，將需重新取得的證據與可沿用證據分開。測試工時包含案例執行與環境設定、資料復原及證據整理。平行化只有在資源和狀態真正獨立時有效；把多個會修改同一狀態的測試同時執行，可能造成結果不可重現，表面節省時間卻增加診斷成本。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。~Analyse which requirements and tests a design change affects, separating evidence that must be regenerated from evidence that remains applicable. Test effort includes case execution, setup, state restoration and evidence handling. Parallelism helps only when resources and state are genuinely independent. Concurrent tests modifying one shared state can become irreproducible, apparently saving execution time while increasing diagnostic cost. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。公式 y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60，代入得 y=19 h。邊界：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min. Formula y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60 gives y=19 h. Boundary: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
units.verify: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。以「變更後證據重建」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns. For rebuilding evidence after change, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「變更後證據重建」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Trace the input chain for rebuilding evidence after change. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果~All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.
units.practice: 只把測試案例數 cases 從 120 改成 121 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 19 變為 19.1333 h。先說明「變更後證據重建」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only test cases cases from 120 to 121 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 19 to 19.1333 h. Explain the causal direction for rebuilding evidence after change, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

facts: 教學假設：頂事件邏輯選擇採 p1=0.001 1；本課公式結果 0.002998 1，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for selecting top-event logic: p1=0.001 1; this model gives 0.002998 1, not a field rating.
